<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>Motor City Hockey Drill Builder</title>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.2/Sortable.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{--red:#d71920;--black:#0a0a0a;--ink:#171717;--muted:#6b6b6b;--line:#dedede;--paper:#fff;--wash:#f4f4f4;--radius:16px;--shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;background:#efefef;color:var(--ink)}
button,input,select{font:inherit}.mch-app{max-width:1480px;margin:0 auto;min-height:100vh;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.mch-header{background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:18px clamp(16px,3vw,34px);display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:5px solid var(--red)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.brand-mark{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:1000;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-2px}.brand-title{font-size:clamp(18px,2.6vw,28px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.7px}.brand-sub{font-size:12px;color:#bdbdbd;margin-top:2px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.6px}
.header-pill{border:1px solid #3a3a3a;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px;color:#ddd;white-space:nowrap}.header-pill b{color:#fff}
.set-zone{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:#111;color:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #262626;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.set-head{padding:12px clamp(14px,3vw,30px) 8px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.set-title{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-weight:900}.count-badge{background:var(--red);border-radius:999px;min-width:28px;height:28px;padding:0 8px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px}.set-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.btn-red{background:var(--red);color:#fff}.btn-ghost{background:#242424;color:#fff;border:1px solid #3a3a3a}.btn-light{background:#fff;color:#111;border:1px solid #ddd}.btn-small{padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px}
.selected-strip{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px clamp(14px,3vw,30px) 14px;scroll-snap-type:x proximity}.selected-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{height:7px}.selected-strip::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#444;border-radius:99px}.selected-empty{padding:10px 0 4px;color:#aaa;font-size:13px}
.sel-card{position:relative;flex:0 0 146px;background:#fff;color:#111;border-radius:12px;padding:7px;border:2px solid transparent;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.18);scroll-snap-align:start;cursor:grab}.sel-card.dragging{opacity:.45;border-color:var(--red)}.sel-card img{width:100%;height:88px;object-fit:contain;background:#f5f5f5;border-radius:8px}.sel-order{position:absolute;left:3px;top:3px;width:28px;height:28px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000}.sel-remove{position:absolute;right:3px;top:3px;width:25px;height:25px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#000;color:#fff;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}.sel-meta{padding-top:5px}.sel-number{font-weight:950;font-size:13px}.sel-book{font-size:10px;color:#6b6b6b;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.sel-move{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:5px}.sel-move button{flex:1;border:1px solid #ddd;background:#fafafa;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;padding:3px;cursor:pointer}
.builder{padding:22px clamp(14px,3vw,30px) 30px}.quick-panel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d0d0d,#232323);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-left:5px solid var(--red)}.quick-title{font-weight:1000;font-size:18px}.quick-sub{color:#bdbdbd;font-size:12px;margin-top:3px}.quick-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .55fr auto;gap:9px;margin-top:14px}.field{min-width:0}.field label{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#aaa;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.8px;margin:0 0 5px 2px}.control{width:100%;height:44px;border:1px solid #444;background:#151515;color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:0 11px;outline:none}.control:focus{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(215,25,32,.2)}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}.section-title{font-size:22px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.4px}.section-sub{font-size:12px;color:#777;margin-top:2px}.search-wrap{display:flex;gap:8px;flex:1;justify-content:flex-end;min-width:260px}.search{min-width:240px;max-width:420px;width:100%;height:42px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:10px;padding:0 12px}
.category-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;overflow:auto;padding:14px 0 10px}.cat{border:1px solid #d7d7d7;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 12px;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.cat.active{background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-color:var(--black)}.cat .mini-count{color:#999;margin-left:5px}.cat.active .mini-count{color:#bbb}
.filter-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 14px}.filter-row select{height:40px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:9px;padding:0 10px;background:#fff}.hint{font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-left:auto}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px}.drill-card{position:relative;border:1px solid #dedede;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.04);transition:.16s;min-width:0}.drill-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.09);border-color:#bbb}.drill-card.selected{border:2px solid var(--red);padding:7px}.drill-card img{width:100%;height:150px;object-fit:contain;background:#f7f7f7;border-radius:9px}.drill-n{font-weight:1000;margin-top:7px;font-size:14px}.drill-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.drill-desc{font-size:10px;color:#777;margin-top:3px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;min-height:26px}.drill-book{font-size:9px;color:#999;margin-top:5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.add-chip{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#111;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}.drill-card.selected .add-chip{background:var(--red);font-size:14px}.empty-library{grid-column:1/-1;border:1px dashed #ccc;border-radius:14px;padding:40px;text-align:center;color:#777;background:#fafafa}
.export-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);z-index:100;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px}.export-modal.open{display:flex}.modal-card{width:min(620px,100%);background:#fff;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 25px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}.modal-head{background:#111;color:#fff;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:4px solid var(--red);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.modal-head h3{margin:0;font-size:20px}.modal-body{padding:20px}.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px}.seg button{border:1px solid #ccc;background:#fff;padding:12px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}.seg button.active{background:#111;color:#fff;border-color:#111}.export-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}.export-options label{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;color:#666;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}.export-options select,.export-options input{width:100%;height:42px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:9px;padding:0 10px}.modal-note{background:#f4f4f4;border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding:10px 12px;margin-top:14px;font-size:11px;color:#555}.modal-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:18px}.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);background:#111;color:#fff;border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding:11px 15px;border-radius:9px;z-index:200;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;font-size:12px}.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.footer{padding:20px 30px;background:#111;color:#aaa;font-size:11px;border-top:4px solid var(--red);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:1100px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:850px){.quick-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.quick-grid .add-cell{grid-column:1/-1}.quick-grid .add-cell button{width:100%}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.drill-card img{height:135px}.header-pill{display:none}}
@media(max-width:620px){body{background:#fff}.mch-app{box-shadow:none}.mch-header{padding:12px 14px}.brand-mark{width:40px;height:40px}.brand-title{font-size:18px}.brand-sub{font-size:9px}.set-head{padding:9px 12px 6px}.set-actions .btn-ghost{display:none}.selected-strip{padding:4px 12px 10px}.sel-card{flex-basis:126px}.sel-card img{height:75px}.builder{padding:14px 12px 24px}.quick-panel{padding:14px}.quick-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.quick-grid .add-cell{grid-column:auto}.toolbar{align-items:flex-start}.search-wrap{min-width:100%;justify-content:stretch}.search{max-width:none}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.drill-card img{height:125px}.drill-desc{display:none}.hint{width:100%;margin:0}.export-options{grid-template-columns:1fr}.modal-actions{flex-direction:column}.modal-actions .btn{width:100%}.footer{padding:16px 14px}.section-title{font-size:19px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="mch-app" id="mchApp">
  <header class="mch-header">
    <div class="brand"><div class="brand-mark">MC</div><div><div class="brand-title">MOTOR CITY HOCKEY</div><div class="brand-sub">Coach Drill Builder</div></div></div>
    <div class="header-pill"><b>Build fast.</b> Export only what you need.</div>
  </header>

  <section class="set-zone">
    <div class="set-head">
      <div class="set-title">YOUR PRACTICE SET <span class="count-badge" id="selectedCount">0</span></div>
      <div class="set-actions"><button class="btn btn-ghost btn-small" id="clearSetBtn">Clear Set</button><button class="btn btn-red btn-small" id="exportBtn">Export / Print</button></div>
    </div>
    <div class="selected-strip" id="selectedStrip"><div class="selected-empty">Add drills below. Your selected drills stay pinned here and can be reordered.</div></div>
  </section>

  <main class="builder">
    <section class="quick-panel">
      <div class="quick-title">Quick Add by Drill Number</div>
      <div class="quick-sub">Choose a category, type the drill number, and add it instantly.</div>
      <div class="quick-grid">
        <div class="field"><label>Category</label><select class="control" id="quickCategory"></select></div>
        <div class="field"><label>Drill #</label><input class="control" id="quickNumber" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="e.g. 342"/></div>
        <div class="field add-cell"><label>&nbsp;</label><button class="btn btn-red" id="quickAddBtn" style="height:44px">Add Drill</button></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="toolbar">
      <div><div class="section-title">Browse Drill Library</div><div class="section-sub">Tap any drill to add it. Tap a selected drill again to remove it.</div></div>
      <div class="search-wrap"><input class="search" id="searchBox" placeholder="Search drill #, title, description..."/></div>
    </div>
    <div class="category-tabs" id="categoryTabs"></div>
    <div class="filter-row"><select id="sortFilter"><option value="number">Sort: Drill #</option><option value="title">Sort: Title</option></select><div class="hint" id="resultHint"></div></div>
    <div class="grid" id="drillGrid"></div>
  </main>

  <footer class="footer"><div>Motor City Hockey - internal coaching resource builder</div><div>Selected drills only are included in exports.</div></footer>
</div>

<div class="export-modal" id="exportModal" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="modal-card">
    <div class="modal-head"><h3>Export Practice Set</h3><button class="btn btn-ghost btn-small" id="closeExportBtn">Close</button></div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <div class="seg" id="formatSeg"><button class="active" data-format="landscape">Landscape PDF</button><button data-format="portrait">Portrait PDF</button><button data-format="phone">Phone / On-Ice</button></div>
      <div class="export-options">
        <div><label>Page Density</label><select id="densitySelect"><option value="8">8 drills / page</option><option value="12">12 drills / page - compact</option></select></div>
        <div><label>File Name</label><input id="fileName" value="MCH-Practice-Set"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-note" id="exportNote"><b>Landscape:</b> 8 drills per Letter page by default. There is no limit on selected drills; the PDF simply adds pages.</div>
      <div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn btn-light" id="printFallbackBtn">Open Print View</button><button class="btn btn-red" id="generatePdfBtn">Download Selected Drills PDF</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script id="mchSeedData" type="application/json">[{"uid":"travel-1","id":1,"number":1,"category":"Travel Skills","sourceNumber":1,"title":"","description":"","tags":[],"image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","active":true,"version":1},{"uid":"travel-2","id":2,"number":2,"category":"Travel Skills","sourceNumber":2,"title":"","description":"","tags":[],"image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","active":true,"version":1},{"uid":"travel-3","id":3,"number":3,"category":"Travel Skills","sourceNumber":3,"title":"","description":"","tags":[],"image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","active":true,"version":1},{"uid":"travel-4","id":4,"number":4,"category":"Travel Skills","sourceNumber":4,"title":"","description":"","tags":[],"image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","active":true,"version":1},{"uid":"travel-5","id":5,"number":5,"category":"Travel Skills","sourceNumber":5,"title":"","description":"","tags":[],"image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","active":true,"version":1},{"uid":"travel-6","id":6,"number":6,"category":"Travel Skills","sourceNumber":6,"title":"","description":"","tags":[],"image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","active":true,"version":1},{"uid":"travel-7","id":7,"number":7,"category":"Travel Skills","sourceNumber":7,"title":"","description":"","tags":[],"image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,
